models_evaluated: ensemble machine-learning model with group-based trajectory modeling

links.outcome: Model AUROC across development, internal, and external sites
links.effect: AUROC 0.92 (development), 0.89 (internal), 0.84 (MIMIC-III) and 0.77 (eICU), showing performance decline at external sites.
links.quote: In the final binary classification task, AUROC was 0.92 (development), 0.89 (internal), 0.84 (MIMIC-III) and 0.77 (eICU); median warning time before deterioration was 17.6 h (Overall pooled across all cohorts).

screen.reason: The study develops and validates a machine learning model for sepsis deterioration trajectories and evaluates its clinical impact following implementation in an ICU setting, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard variation.
